name: Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Wuyang Automation Control Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automation equipment in China and internationally. The company offers parking lot construction, operation, and management services. It also provides intelligent bulk material handling equipment and control systems, mechanical parking equipment, automated production line equipment, intelligent logistics and warehousing systems, as well as two-station and manufactured sand equipment.
